top_news.title: Gold Edges Up After Four-Day Gain as Traders Eye Treasury Moves
top_news.summary: Gold edged higher as inflation concerns eased, extending a four-day rally sparked by a surprise bond-market intervention that’s revived concerns over US fiscal policy and dollar weakness.

top_news.title: How LeBron James Scored $300 Million From Insurers
top_news.summary: When LeBron James signed up to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to NBA glory with a $154 million contract in 2018, it wasn’t the biggest deal he did that year. His limited liability company borrowed almost $300 million from two Midwestern life insurers, Sridhar Natarajan explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Northrop CEO on Defense Spending, Golden Dome System
top_news.summary: Northrop Grumman Chair, CEO and President Kathy Warden discusses doing business with the Trump administration, working on the Golden Dome space defense system and how geopolitical tensions and active conflicts are fueling a global defense spending boom. She speaks with Bloomberg's Kailey Leinz at a Newsmakers event in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Conference Board CEO: Consumers Worried About the Future
top_news.summary: Steve Odland, CEO of The Conference Board, discussed the recent consumer confidence data showing a significant divergence between current sentiment and future expectations. The present situation index increased by 6.8 points, reflecting consumers' relatively positive feelings due to full employment and rising wages. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: The Mormon Church Is Putting Its Real Estate Empire to Work
top_news.summary: After decades of quietly amassing billions of dollars in land, the institution is investing in more deals and planning massive projects that stand to reshape communities. Bloomberg's Natalie Wong, Ann Choi and Katie Meyer explain. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: EchoStar Deals Worth $1.5 Billion Must be Investigated, US Says
top_news.summary: EchoStar Corp. allegedly engaged in $1.5 billion of “unusual transactions” with its bankrupt subsidiary, Hughes Satellite Systems Corp., according to the US Trustee, who urged the court to appoint an examiner to investigate the deals.

top_news.title: Stocks Rise Before Nvidia as Oil Drop Lifts Bonds: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks rose as a decline in oil prices sent bond yields lower, with traders awaiting Nvidia Corp.’s earnings for clues on whether the outlook for artificial intelligence remains intact.

top_news.title: Intuit Sinks 11% on Weak Outlook as Nvidia Earnings Loom | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Emily Graffeo, Norah Mulinda and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Oil Falls on Fresh Iran War Diplomacy, Talks on Hormuz
top_news.summary: Oil extended declines as fresh diplomatic efforts helped renew optimism the Iran war would not escalate, while a US plan to ramp up economic pressure on Tehran spared the country’s trading partners from harsher measures for now.

top_news.title: Treasuries Gain as Oil Drop Eases Pressure on Inflation, Bessent
top_news.summary: Treasuries gained as a decline in crude-oil prices eased inflation concerns and pressure on Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who has been trying to halt a months-long selloff that pushed the longest-dated yields to the highest in almost two decades.
